purpose: Transaction diligence quality-of-revenue analysis. This method evaluates source-reported revenue quality and collectibility; it does not independently opine on GAAP revenue recognition.
governing_question: What portion of reported healthcare revenue is actually realized, reasonably collectible, recurring and supportable?

rules.gross_charge: Source-recorded billed charge before contractual adjustment.
rules.allowed_amount: Source-recorded payer/contract allowed amount when available. Never infer allowed amount from charge amount without an approved rule.
rules.observed_collections: Verified cash events allocated to in-scope claims with payment_date on or before valuation_date.
rules.open_ar: Source open receivable balance at the approved snapshot date before Redwood recovery haircuts.
rules.expected_remaining_cash: Eligible open A/R multiplied by the approved recovery policy. It is estimated, never observed.
rules.estimated_realizable_revenue: Observed collections + expected remaining cash +/- approved QoR adjustments.

ar_policy.gross_ar: Source open receivable before recovery haircut.
ar_policy.net_recoverable_ar: Expected remaining cash after approved recovery factors; never relabel gross A/R as net without showing the recovery transformation.

review_gates.name: Scope
review_gates.pass_when: valuation date, analysis period, entities, currency and purpose are approved

review_gates.name: Source Sufficiency
review_gates.pass_when: minimum required source populations are present or exclusions are explicitly approved

review_gates.name: Mapping
review_gates.pass_when: canonical mappings are reviewed; unresolved required mappings block release

review_gates.name: Reconciliation
review_gates.pass_when: required bridges are computed and every difference is dispositioned; unresolved differences remain visible

review_gates.name: Calculation
review_gates.pass_when: required analyses reproduce deterministically for the exact method and data run

review_gates.name: Judgment
review_gates.pass_when: recovery policy, assumptions and QoR adjustments are approved by a named reviewer

review_gates.name: Finding Review
review_gates.pass_when: all material and blocking findings have an explicit disposition

review_gates.name: Release
review_gates.pass_when: named reviewer authorizes the exact run/method/output; any upstream change invalidates release
